en: had been grafted on to the basic rural society
context: A new political order had been grafted on to the basic rural society.
meaning: 新政治秩序是嫁接上去的，底下的农村社会没有根本改变
current_zh: 新的政治秩序只是嫁接在原有的农村社会之上
suggest: 新的政治秩序是嫁接在原有的农村社会上的
note: 比喻已保留；“只是”为增译，原文无，删去后语义不变。

en: to tackle the problem head-on
context: Yet to tackle the problem head-on with a purge of the party was to risk the collapse of party rule itself
meaning: 正面硬碰，用清党来直接解决
current_zh: 可是，要靠清洗党来正面解决这个问题
suggest: 可是，要是动真格，靠清党来正面解决问题
note: “动真格”口语，贴 head-on 的决绝感；现译可用。

en: to take his case outside the party
context: We can only surmise at the motives which led Mao to take his case outside the party.
meaning: 把党内官司打到党外去，诉诸党外的公众
current_zh: 毛为什么把党内争端诉诸党外裁决，我们只能推测
suggest: 毛为什么要把官司打到党外去，我们只能猜测
note: take one’s case 是法律用语，“官司打到…”保留比喻，口语，力度相当。

en: when ignominy would be publicly heaped upon the defeated
context: The disputes inside the party were not broadcast to the world at large until after they had been settled, when ignominy would be publicly heaped upon the defeated.
meaning: 争论定局后，失败者被当众大肆羞辱、搞臭
current_zh: 斗争结束以后，失败者才会被公开羞辱
suggest: 定局之后，才把失败者当众搞得声名狼藉
alt: 让失败者当众颜面扫地
note: heap ignominy 有“堆砌”羞辱之意，“声名狼藉”力度相当。“批倒批臭”是文革用语，此处讲的是文革前的党内惯例，时代错位，不推荐。broadcast to the world at large 现译“向外界公开”可。

en: we have only Mao’s side of the case
context: Even the arguments within the party are not clear—we have only Mao’s side of the case.
meaning: 现有材料只是毛单方面的说法，未必可尽信
current_zh: 我们看到的基本只是毛一方的说法
suggest: 我们看到的只是毛的一面之词
note: “一面之词”恰对 one side of the case，略带不可尽信之意，与上句“争论本身并不清楚”一致；现译“基本”是增译。

en: scourge the provincial and national leadership
context: or did he hope to do no more than scourge the provincial and national leadership as the basis for establishing a stronger loyalty to them
meaning: 狠狠鞭打、整一整各级领导层（但不打倒）
current_zh: 只想敲打省级和中央领导层
suggest: 只想狠狠敲打一下省级和中央领导层
note: scourge 本义鞭笞，比“敲打”重，加“狠狠”补足；do no more than（仅此而已）要保留。

en: The recorded pretext was slight.
context: Without access to the inner party discussions, the answers cannot be verified. The recorded pretext was slight.
meaning: 见诸记载的起因（借口）很小
current_zh: 公开记录中用来发动运动的理由并不重大。
suggest: 见诸记载的由头微不足道。
alt: 有据可查的起因不过是件小事
note: pretext 是“由头、借口”，现译翻译腔；“微不足道”贴 slight。不要用“小题大做”，那是作者没明说的判断。

en: as an inducement
context: The students must be involved in the reform; and as an inducement, it was promised that students of worker or peasant origin would receive preference in higher education
meaning: 作为拉拢学生的甜头
current_zh: 作为诱因
suggest: 为了给学生一点甜头
note: 现译“诱因”是误用（诱因指引发原因）；“甜头”口语贴切，“诱饵”贬义稍重。

en: to torment their tormentors
context: Now at last they were given an opportunity to torment their tormentors, the local instruments of the national plan, teachers, headmasters, professors.
meaning: 反过来折磨曾经折磨自己的人
current_zh: 如今，他们终于有机会折磨那些折磨自己的人
suggest: 如今，他们终于可以反过来整那些整过他们的人
alt: 以其人之道，还治其人之身
note: 原文是同词重复的修辞，“整/整过”同样重复，口语自然；“以其人之道还治其人之身”强调用同样手段，原文未必有此意，作备选。

en: the Big Character posters that blossomed on the walls of the cities
context: The work teams of the party attempted to defend a stable administration, and, as a result, were attacked both directly and through the Big Character posters that blossomed on the walls of the cities.
meaning: 大字报像花一样在城市墙上四处冒出来
current_zh: 也受到遍布城市墙壁的大字报的声讨
suggest: 也遭到满城墙上遍地开花的大字报的攻击
note: blossom 或暗合“百花齐放”，“遍地开花”保留花的意象，是中文现成说法；“铺天盖地”也贴切但丢了花。现译“声讨”比 attacked 略文。

en: aped by the Red Guards
context: Mao regularly appeared in army uniform (aped by the Red Guards), as did the other leading members of the reorganized Cultural Revolution group.
meaning: 红卫兵依样模仿（带轻蔑）
current_zh: 红卫兵随之模仿
suggest: 红卫兵也照猫画虎跟着穿
note: ape 带轻蔑，“照猫画虎”有依样模仿、徒具其形之意，力度相当；“东施效颦”过重。

en: one not tethered to the material interests of the majority
context: For that, a more widespread force was required, and one not tethered to the material interests of the majority, workers and peasants.
meaning: 不被多数人的物质利益拴住
current_zh: 而且这支力量还不能受大多数人——工人和农民——的物质利益牵制
suggest: 而且不能被多数人——工人和农民——的物质利益拴住手脚
note: “拴住手脚”保留 tether 的拴绑意象。

en: pampered children of the bourgeoisie
context: Indeed, workers, peasants and soldiers reacted initially by opposing the student Red Guards, accusing them of being pampered children of the bourgeoisie.
meaning: 娇生惯养的资产阶级子弟（工农兵的指责）
current_zh: 指责他们是资产阶级的娇子
suggest: 指责他们是娇生惯养的资产阶级少爷小姐
note: “娇子”生僻；“少爷小姐”是工农口吻，贴切；“公子哥儿”只指男性。

en: an audience whose expectations pushed and pulled him in other directions
context: But Mao was now responding to an audience whose expectations pushed and pulled him in other directions.
meaning: 听众的期待把毛往不同方向推来拉去
current_zh: 而这批听众的期待正把他推向别的方向
suggest: 这批听众的期待，把他往别的方向推来拉去
note: 现译只有“推”，丢了 pulled。

en: permitted Mao complete freedom to manoeuvre
context: There is a gap between the “comrades” criticized and the rhetoric of enforcing a “bourgeois dictatorship”, a gap of vagueness which permitted Mao complete freedom to manoeuvre, to speak the language of revolution while persisting in a programme of limited reforms.
meaning: 含糊留出的空间让毛可以完全自由地周旋
current_zh: 正是这种含糊，使毛得以进退自如
suggest: 正是这种含糊，让毛进退自如
note: “进退自如”贴切，现译已妥；complete 可不另译。

en: Sound the retreat
context: (ii) Sound the retreat
meaning: 小节标题：吹响退兵号，指毛开始收兵
current_zh: ## 二、收缩信号
suggest: 二、鸣金收兵
note: 军事习语，“鸣金收兵”分毫不差，场景在中国，无典故错位；现译“收缩信号”丢了比喻，也不像标题。

en: the grandiose language which caught the imagination of the students
context: Nonetheless the irritations—despite the grandiose language which caught the imagination of the students—still did not mean that the “top persons” should be cast out
meaning: 那套宏大的说辞让学生心驰神往
current_zh: 尽管表述这些不满的宏大语言激发了学生的想象
suggest: 尽管那套大话让学生心驰神往
note: caught the imagination 是“吸引、打动”，“激发了想象”是直译腔；“热血沸腾”力度偏强；grandiose 有夸大意，“大话”略贬，合作者语气。现译后文“一开始”为增译。

en: were prey to any ambitious leader prepared to speak in extreme terms
context: Finally, the Red Guards, young and innocent, were prey to any ambitious leader prepared to speak in extreme terms.
meaning: 年轻天真的红卫兵容易被任何敢说极端话的野心家利用
current_zh: 最后，红卫兵年轻而天真，任何野心家只要肯说极端的话，就能把他们当作猎物
suggest: 最后，红卫兵年轻天真，哪个野心家肯说极端的话，就能拿他们当枪使
note: “当枪使”是中文现成说法，指被人利用，贴 prey to ambitious leaders；“猎物”直译生硬。

en: the sacrifice of Liu, Deng and the rest was required as the price of the survival of his own authority
context: In October Mao decided that the sacrifice of Liu, Deng and the rest was required as the price of the survival of his own authority.
meaning: 牺牲刘邓等人，是保住毛自身权威的代价
current_zh: 1966 年 10 月，毛决定，牺牲刘少奇、邓小平以及其他人，是保住自己权威所必须付出的代价
suggest: 1966年10月，毛决定弃车保帅：牺牲刘少奇、邓小平等人，保住自己的权威
alt: 牺牲刘、邓等人，换取自己权威的保全
note: “弃车保帅”分毫不差，原文 sacrifice…price 已有冷酷算计之意；但带象棋意象，“帅”指毛本人，略显戏谑，主控可视全书语体决定，拿不准就用备选的平实说法。

en: The confession did them no good.
context: Liu and Deng were obliged to make a public confession, accepting a version of the past that was clearly false ... The confession did them no good.
meaning: 检讨毫无用处
current_zh: 检讨没有救他们。
suggest: 检讨也无济于事。
note: “无济于事”分毫不差、自然。

en: To no avail.
context: The students were directed to leave Beijing, to “go on a Long March” to wherever they came from. To no avail.
meaning: （劝学生回乡）白费力气
current_zh: 可是这没有效果。
suggest: 结果徒劳无功。
note: 固定短语；与下一句“检讨也无济于事”相邻时避免用同一成语。

en: to fuel the growing militancy on the streets
context: Free rail travel permitted thousands of those exiled to the rural areas to return to their cities legitimately, and to fuel the growing militancy on the streets.
meaning: 给街头日益高涨的激进情绪添柴加火
current_zh: 进一步点燃街头日益增长的激进情绪
suggest: 给街头日益高涨的斗争情绪又添了一把火
note: “添一把火”中性；不用“火上浇油”“推波助澜”，二者带贬义，作者对工人的激进并无贬意。

en: The PLA endeavoured to hold the line.
context: The PLA endeavoured to hold the line. It was the only secure base of power for the leadership.
meaning: 解放军努力守住阵线、稳住局面
current_zh: 人民解放军努力守住底线。
suggest: 人民解放军竭力稳住阵脚。
note: hold the line 是军事习语“守住阵线”；现译“底线”是现代引申义（最低限度），意思偏了。p.81 rewarded for having held the line 现译作“守住底线”并加了原文没有的引号，应一并改为“稳住阵脚”。

en: it was small, spread thinly
context: But it was small, spread thinly, aware of the dangers lurking beyond China’s borders
meaning: 兵力不多，又分散得很薄
current_zh: 可是它人数不多，分布很散
suggest: 可是它兵力不多，摊得又薄
note: spread thinly 有“摊薄”之意，“摊得薄”保留。

en: Mao added his quotation to clinch the point
context: Mao added his quotation to clinch the point: “We must believe that more than ninety per cent of our cadres are good or comparatively good.”
meaning: 毛再拿一句语录来一锤定音
current_zh: 毛又用一句话为此定调
suggest: 毛又拿出一句语录，一锤定音
note: clinch 是最后敲定，“一锤定音”分毫不差；“定调”是先定方向，不合。his quotation 暗讽语录崇拜，宜译“语录”。

en: serried ranks of disciplined bureaucrats
context: It was the strength of the State, with its monopoly of armed power and serried ranks of disciplined bureaucrats, which meant it would inevitably win unless alternative organizations were created.
meaning: 排列严整、纪律严明的官僚队伍
current_zh: 拥有阵容严整、纪律严明的官僚队伍
suggest: 拥有阵容严整、纪律严明的官僚队伍
note: 现译已妥。

en: All efforts were now bent to root out
context: All efforts were now bent to root out this “counter-revolutionary Hotch Potch” as a leading Hunan newspaper described it.
meaning: 全力把这个组织连根拔掉
current_zh: 于是，清除这个被《湖南日报》称为“反革命大杂烩”的东西，成了首要任务。
suggest: 于是全力以赴，要把这个被湖南一家大报称为“反革命大杂烩”的组织连根拔掉。
note: root out 有连根拔除意，“斩草除根”过狠。原文只说 a leading Hunan newspaper，现译坐实为《湖南日报》，需核。

en: backed the wrong group
context: General Chen Caidao, the Wuhan commander, backed the wrong group, the One Million Heroes Rebel Group for the “triple alliance”
meaning: 押错了宝、站错了队
current_zh: 武汉军区司令陈再道站错了队
suggest: 武汉军区司令陈再道站错了队
note: “站错队”中文现成，现译已妥。但现译后文“这同中央要建立的“三结合”安排相冲突”是误读：原文是他支持“百万雄师”进入“三结合”。

en: a thousand houses in Guangxi had been razed to the ground
context: Lin Biao reported that a thousand houses in Guangxi had been razed to the ground because no one would let the fire-fighting equipment be used.
meaning: 上千间房屋被夷为平地（此处是火烧）
current_zh: 广西有上千间房屋被烧毁
suggest: 广西有上千间房屋烧成了白地
note: razed to the ground 是夷为平地；结合消防设备，可用“烧成白地”；现译“烧毁”丢了程度。

en: The civil war seemed to break out in new areas as soon as it had been mastered in one place.
context: The civil war seemed to break out in new areas as soon as it had been mastered in one place.
meaning: 内战此处刚压下，彼处又起
current_zh: 内战似乎刚在一处被压住，就在另一处重新爆发。
suggest: 内战此起彼伏，按下葫芦浮起瓢。
note: “按下葫芦浮起瓢”分毫不差且生动，但口语俏皮，作者此句语气平实，若嫌油滑只用“此起彼伏”。

en: to clear up the debris
context: In April 1969, the Ninth Party Congress met to clear up the debris, to attempt to restore some of the decimated national leadership in the face of the Russian threat.
meaning: 收拾文革造成的残局
current_zh: 任务是在苏联威胁面前清理废墟
suggest: 收拾残局
note: debris 是比喻，“收拾残局”是中文现成说法，分毫不差；“清理废墟”直译生硬。

en: to give the Chinese the taste for peaches, and to keep all the fruit on the tree
context: The task, as he saw it, was to awaken “political consciousness” while “saving the revolutionaries from their besetting temptation to exploit the revolution for their own pleasure”; or “to give the Chinese the taste for peaches, and to keep all the fruit on the tree”.
meaning: 既要让人尝到甜头、生出欲望，又不许摘果子——自相矛盾的要求
current_zh: 也就是既要让中国人尝到桃子的味道，又要让所有果子都留在树上
suggest: 或者说，“既要让中国人爱上桃子的滋味，又要让果子一个不少地留在树上”
alt: 既要马儿跑，又要马儿不吃草
note: 这是被引法国作者的比喻（英译、引号内，不是中文原始文献），宜保留桃子意象，并恢复现译丢掉的引号；taste for 是“嗜好、爱上”，不只是“尝到”。桃子或暗合毛泽东“摘桃子”之说，可酌加译注。中文俗语“既要马儿跑，又要马儿不吃草”意思吻合，只宜用于译注。
